description: At night the Monumental City of Cáceres glows in its stones — the baroque church of San Francisco Javier with its twin towers rises illuminated over the Plaza de San Jorge, while the medieval noble palaces around the square hold the night lighting in their façades. Visitors call the old town particularly beautiful at night, and the evening tours end with the historic buildings shining in the dark. A thousand coats of arms sleep in the quiet streets.
